services.desc: Find the perfect electric boat for your next adventure on Newport Harbor. Whether you’re planning a family outing, sunset cruise, date night, celebration, or relaxing day on the water, EB Rental offers private electric boat rentals in Newport Beach for every occasion. Our boats accommodate up to 10 passengers, are easy to operate, and require no boating experience or boating license. Applicable fees are added to all reservations, including a Booking Platform Fee and Administrative Fee. These fees will be displayed during the booking process prior to checkout.
